name: xoga750-fix1-gpc-valuation-date-dev
description: DEV ONLY. Sets the GPC valuation date to value 2026-11-06 and settlement 2026-11-05 so a GPC Trade run with fill files gives Transaction Date 05-Nov-2026, as old Opera did. Today the GPC row holds value 2026-11-23 and settlement 2026-11-20, written by the 21-Nov migration load (updated_by migration); the GPC pipeline reads settlement_date of this row (reference valuationDate in the GPC - All config). One row changes; every other business unit is untouched. Side effect to know: anything on dev that reads the GPC valuation date (reports, caches) sees 05-Nov until the undo rule is applied.

preconditions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE {{where}} AND value_date = DATE '2026-11-23' AND settlement_date = DATE '2026-11-20'
preconditions.reason: the GPC row still has the migration values, so nobody changed it since this rule was written
